title: The Salt of Caerlum
author: Ines Joubert
blurb: Hazel Villalobos, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
